page_title: EVE 1-0 BUR | Everton v Burnley 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Burnley comes to nothing.
90+3' Everton quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+3' Beto (Everton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Everton will take a corner.
90+2' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Sander Berge (Burnley) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
88' Beto (Everton) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
86' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 37:63.
84' Charlie Taylor will be replaced by Zeki Amdouni (Burnley).
84' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Wilson Odobert and he is replaced by Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley).
84' Substitution. Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) has come on for Lorenz Assignon.
84' Sean Dyche has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Beto (Everton) replacing Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
83' That will be all from Ashley Young who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jack Harrison (Everton).

80' That's a well-taken pass by Dwight McNeil (Everton). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
79' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) was waiting for the ball on the edge of the box and produced a powerful volley goalwards, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save and to deny him.
77' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

75' Arijanet Muric pulls off a great save to deny Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!

73' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
71' Everton are ruled offside.

70' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
69' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Josh Brownhill (Burnley) replaces Jacob Bruun Larsen.
67' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) takes out his opponent with a nasty slide tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
66' Andre Gomes (Everton) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
65' Josh Cullen (Burnley) makes a slide tackle, but referee Michael Oliver blows for a foul. Everton get a free kick.
63' PENALTY APPEAL after Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
61' A substitution has been made. David Datro Fofana goes off and Vitinho (Burnley) comes on.

61' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
59' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom left corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
59' Burnley have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Burnley earn a corner.
54' Seamus Coleman (Everton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
49' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
47' The free kick is delivered by Andre Gomes (Everton) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' 1 - 0 GOAL! Keeper Arijanet Muric totally miss kicks the ball straight to Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton), who slams the ball into the net from mid range. It’s now 1:0.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Today's referee Michael Oliver rightly decides to book Andre Gomes (Everton) for his harsh tackle.
45' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
43' Andre Gomes (Everton) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
41' Ashley Young (Everton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
40' A corner kick by Burnley is thwarted by the well prepared Jordan Pickford (Everton).

39' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Burnley are awarded a corner kick.
38' Seamus Coleman (Everton) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
36' Dwight McNeil (Everton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
34' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to James Tarkowski (Everton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
34' Josh Cullen (Burnley) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
33' James Tarkowski (Everton) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Burnley are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
31' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
28' A pass from Wilson Odobert (Burnley) is intercepted by Jordan Pickford and the move breaks down.
26' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
25' Ashley Young (Everton) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
24' The linesman raises his flag. Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is adjudged offside.
22' Josh Cullen (Burnley) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
21' Sander Berge (Burnley) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Good work from Burnley as they win a corner.
21' That's unlucky! Dwight McNeil (Everton) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
19' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
18' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
17' Everton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

17' Andre Gomes (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
15' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Dwight McNeil (Everton).
11' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Michael Oliver saw the whole situation.
8' The corner from Dwight McNeil (Everton) is intercepted by the defence.
7' Ashley Young (Everton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Everton have a corner.
5' Lyle Foster (Burnley) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Burnley will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Michael Oliver.
